# Yash Savaliya

> Yash Savaliya is a Full Stack .NET Developer and Data Analyst based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. He builds SaaS applications with ASP.NET Core, Angular and Azure at iTechOps (since 2024) and analyzes data with SQL, Python (Pandas), Excel and Power BI.

## Projects
- [Ahmedabad RERA Market & Cost Variance Analytics](https://yashsavaliya1113.github.io/portfolio/projects/ahmedabad-rera-data-analytics/): Analysis of 5,478 Ahmedabad RERA registrations using Excel, with a live dashboard.
- [SaaS Reliability & Incident Intelligence](https://yashsavaliya1113.github.io/portfolio/projects/saas-reliability-incident-intelligence/): SQL and Pandas analysis of a clearly disclosed synthetic incident dataset, with a dashboard.
- [Incident Management Platform](https://yashsavaliya1113.github.io/portfolio/projects/incident-management-platform/): White-label status page and incident management SaaS (ASP.NET Core MVC, Azure SQL).
- [Payment Gateway](https://yashsavaliya1113.github.io/portfolio/projects/payment-gateway/): FinTech platform with open banking payments and KYC (.NET, Blazor, RabbitMQ, Redis).
- [White-Label Assessment Platform](https://yashsavaliya1113.github.io/portfolio/projects/white-label-assessment-platform/): Multi-tenant assessment SaaS (.NET microservices, GraphQL, Angular). In progress.
